godrick_pendlebrook.expression: warm, earnest, a big heroic grin
godrick_pendlebrook.look: Sir Godrick Pendlebrook, a classic heroic paladin: a huge, big and burly young goliath man about seven and a half feet tall, with light stone-grey skin faintly marked with darker grey patches, long flowing golden-blonde hair to his shoulders, a short blonde goatee, a square, handsome, friendly face and a warm grin, wearing polished steel chain mail under a sky-blue tabard with a white sunburst, a round steel shield on his left arm, a longsword with a worn griffin pommel at his hip, and brown leather boots
godrick_pendlebrook.who: Sir Godrick Pendlebrook, a huge goliath paladin
godrick_pendlebrook.windup: the longsword raised high over his right shoulder, the round shield held up in front of his chest, feet planted wide, leaning back
godrick_pendlebrook.strike: the longsword swung down and across in front of him at chest height, the shield pulled in, leaning his whole weight into the blow

liriel_dawnsong.look: Liriel Dawnsong, a slight, graceful high elf woman with long straight pale-gold hair, pointed ears, a delicate serene face and large grey eyes, wearing flowing cream and soft gold priestly robes over a light chain shirt, a gold sunburst holy symbol on a chain at her breast, a small round shield on her arm and a slender mace at her belt
liriel_dawnsong.who: Liriel Dawnsong, an elf cleric of the dawn
liriel_dawnsong.windup: the gold sunburst holy symbol raised high in her right hand, a small gathering glow of warm golden light around it, her other hand at her heart, robes swirling
liriel_dawnsong.strike: the holy symbol thrust out toward the enemy at shoulder height with a burst of golden light leaving it, leaning forward onto the front foot

thistle.look: Thistle, a wiry young human woman in her early twenties with a wild mane of tangled russet-red hair with black crow feathers braided into it, freckled sun-browned skin and a wide grin, wearing patched studded leather armour, a fur-trimmed moss-green hooded cloak, fingerless gloves, a longbow and a quiver of arrows on her back and a scimitar at her hip, and worn hide boots
thistle.windup: the longbow raised and fully drawn, an arrow nocked and the string pulled back to her cheek, bow arm straight toward the enemy, feet apart
thistle.strike: the arrow loosed, the bowstring snapped forward and the arrow flying toward the enemy, her drawing hand flung back past her ear

ratatoille.look: Ratatoille, a slim, gangly young high elf man with neat dark-brown hair, pointed ears, round wire spectacles and an eager, pinched face, wearing a deep plum wizard's robe with gold trim, a white cook's apron tied over it, a battered copper skillet hanging at his belt beside a leather-bound spellbook, and holding a carved wooden staff
ratatoille.who: Ratatoille, an elf wizard and cook
ratatoille.windup: the wooden staff raised high in the right hand, the left hand pulled back beside the hip with fingers curled around a small orange flame, torso leaning back
ratatoille.strike: the left arm thrust straight out toward the enemy at shoulder height with the palm open and a burst of orange flame leaving it, the staff swept forward too, robes and apron swinging

wren_featherfoot.look: Wren Featherfoot, a small, lean, athletic halfling man with short curly sandy-brown hair, a cheeky grin and quick bright eyes, barefoot, wearing a sleeveless sky-blue and grey monk's wrap tunic with a rope sash, loose grey trousers tied at the ankles, and cloth wraps around his wrists and forearms
wren_featherfoot.windup: crouched low and coiled on the balls of his feet, the right fist pulled back beside his ribs, the left open hand held forward for balance
wren_featherfoot.strike: springing forward in a long lunge, the right fist driven straight out at full arm's length at the enemy, the back leg straight and the heel lifted

kip_smudgewick.look: Kip Smudgewick, a friendly tiefling man in his early thirties with maroon-red skin, curling dark-grey ram's horns, a long thin tail, golden eyes and an anxious smile, wearing a wide-brimmed straw hat, a mustard-yellow shirt with rolled sleeves, a brown leather waistcoat, a green canvas apron with pockets full of orange apricots, a small black book on a chain at his hip, brown breeches and boots
kip_smudgewick.windup: both hands pulled back beside his right hip with a crackling ball of violet energy gathering between the palms, knees bent, leaning back
kip_smudgewick.strike: both hands thrust straight out toward the enemy at chest height with a beam of crackling violet energy leaving them, leaning forward onto the front foot, the straw hat tilted back
